content:
fran-peopleops: FYI we're publishing a tidy-up of handbook language for PTO examples, parental leave timelines, and the expense receipt checklist. Editorial clarifications only 1 no changes to accruals or eligibility. Managers asked to finish a short 12-20m micro-training and confirm via the manager ack list by 2026-07-15. Details & diff: https://internal.redwood/handbook/editorial-jul-2026 :sparkles:

lee-hrops: Thanks Fran. Where can leads see the highlighted changes quickly?

fran-peopleops: Put a one-page summary and highlighted diff at /shared/hr/handbook_jul2026/highlights.pdf. Also added a tiny Qs doc for managers.

noah-englead: Quick question 1 does the expense section change what qualifies as a reimbursable digital invoice? Our contractors sometimes submit screenshots.

fran-peopleops: Good call 1 we clarified acceptable formats (PDF, emailed invoice, or line-item screenshot with vendor name + date). Screenshots are acceptable only if they include vendor and date. No change to approval flow.

maya-ic: Can I request a manual add to the manager ack list? My new manager mapping hasn't flowed through yet.

lee-hrops: Yes 1 send a CSV with columns: name,email,team,lead_type and we'll append it. Prefer SFTP upload to /incoming/hr/ to keep logs.

opsbot: Reminder scheduled 1 nudge emails go out 7 and 2 days before deadline. Training link: https://training.redwood/handbook-edit-2026 (12-20m).

ken-peopleops: For infra - here's a simple export command we use in the HR tools container:```bash
./tools/export_leads --out=csv --cols=name,email,team,role --filter="active" > manager_ack_jul2026.csv
```

noah-englead: Thanks, will validate the CSV and return any missing leads by EOD.

maya-ic: Completed training 77

fran-peopleops: Appreciate it. We'll post the live ack tracker to /shared/hr/ack_tracker_jul2026.csv once the audit finishes. Q&A drop-in scheduled Wed 10:00am PT 1 invite sent. If anyone spots wording that looks substantive, flag here immediately. :eyes:
